name: Meitantei Conan: Tantei Ryoku Trainer
original_name: 名探偵コナン 探偵力トレーナー
source:
A "Detective meter" is invented to measure detective power consisting of judgment, analysis, concentration, memory and observation. Detective Conan solves incidents while raising his parameters. Will he win competition with numerous rivals?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-april-2007-zwei-worter.html]vndbreview[/url]]
